title: Personal Credit Cards: annual fee and first-year waiver by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: annual fee by tier

This quick reference covers the Personal Credit Cards line and states, for each card tier, the annual fee and whether that fee is not charged in the first account year. The annual fee is the fee charged once a year on the statement that closes in the account's anniversary month.

## Tier table

| Card tier | Annual fee | Not charged in the first account year |
|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| College Rewards Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 0.00 USD | no |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 95.00 USD | yes |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 395.00 USD | no |

## Equivalent reading

- Four tiers carry no annual fee at all: Secured Visa, College Rewards Visa, Platinum Low Rate Visa and Cash Rewards Visa.
- Travel Rewards Visa Signature carries a 95.00 USD annual fee and is the only tier whose first-year waiver is set to yes.
- Visa Infinite Private Client carries a 395.00 USD annual fee and has no first-year waiver.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Is the Visa Infinite Private Client annual fee waived in the first account year?**
A: No. The first-year waiver for that tier is set to no.

**Q: Does a no-fee tier ever show a first-year waiver?**
A: The waiver setting is no on all four no-fee tiers; with an annual fee of 0.00 USD there is nothing to waive.
